parameter_changes.proposal: MUST publish proposed JSON and its canonical SHA-256 before activation.
parameter_changes.visibility: MUST expose diff against prior version.
parameter_changes.effective_epoch: MUST be declared before activation and replay-verifiable.

genesis_corrections.replay: MUST preserve defective parent visibility and computed hash.

activation.requirement: MUST provide commit-pinned raw URL and SHA-256 verification.

deprecation.rule: MUST mark prior model as deprecated but replay-visible.
deprecation.immutability: MUST NOT delete or rewrite prior JSON.

rejection.rule: MUST emit computed hash and mismatch reason.

invariants: Governance rules bind all future parameter objects.
All changes must be replay-verifiable from public surfaces.
